title: Day 028 — Month 01 Capstone Project: Master Aviation Ecosystem Map & Regulatory Reference Guide
regulatory_anchor: ICAO Doc 7300, TFEU Article 288, (EU) 2018/1139, and Easy Access Rules
executive_summary: Today's capstone synthesizes the four foundational pillars of Month 01 into a unified operational artifact: The Master Aviation Ecosystem Map and Regulatory Reference Guide. It connects global public international law, supranational regional legislation, national state oversight, certified operational organizations, and closed-loop frontline evidentiary proof into a single cohesive architecture.

pillars.title: Tier 1: Global Constitutional Order (ICAO)
pillars.summary: Covers the Chicago Convention (Doc 7300) establishing airspace sovereignty (Article 1), 19 ICAO Annexes containing Standards and Recommended Practices (SARPs), PANS series documents, and USOAP continuous monitoring.

pillars.title: Tier 2: Supranational Law (EU & EASA)
pillars.summary: Governed by TFEU Article 288 ensuring direct applicability of EU regulations, Basic Regulation (EU) 2018/1139 establishing EASA competence, the 7 EASA domains, and Easy Access Rules separating hard law from soft law.

pillars.title: Tier 3: National Aviation Authorities (NAAs)
pillars.summary: State-level oversight where National Civil Aviation Authorities issue AOCs, pilot licenses, and aerodrome certifications, while publishing Aeronautical Information Publications (AIP) including GEN 1.7 state differences.

pillars.title: Tier 4: Certified Operational Organizations
pillars.summary: Industry operators including Airlines under Part-CAT, Accountable Managers under ORO.GEN.210, Continuing Airworthiness Management Organizations (CAMO), Part-145 maintenance repair stations, and ANSPs.

pillars.title: Tier 5: Closed-Loop Frontline Execution & Proof
pillars.summary: Utilizes the Quad-Link Traceability Architecture to bind statutory rules down through postholder processes and frontline standard operating procedures to indestructible operational proof such as Tech Log CRS sign-offs.

warning_box.title: Regulatory Hierarchy & Constraint Intersect Warning
warning_box.description: Operators must always verify that national AIP local restrictions and stricter state rules do not conflict with broader EASA or ICAO permissions. Tripartite constraint intersections must be satisfied simultaneously for every flight dispatch.
